panels.sample_scope: Supplementary Fig. 20 | Moisture states and diagnosed processes during the rise to near-peak intensity. a,b, Specific humidity at 700 hPa in the 100–300 km and 300–800 km annuli, respectively. Each point is one cyclone: jointly observed 10 kt bins are averaged within each event, then events within SID. The 108 same-SID pairs compare rise and Resolution states on shared wind ranges; dashed lines indicate equal humidity. c,d, Horizontal and vertical advection, residual and moving-frame tendency integrated over the actual trough-to-return intervals. Bars are equal-SID means after averaging events within SID, with percentile 95% intervals from 2,000 SID resamples. Complete common process records retain 122 cyclones in c and 121 in d. Positive vertical contributions are opposed by horizontal advection and the residual. The outlined tendency is the diagnostic sum of the three coloured terms, not an additional input. These rate integrals and observed endpoint changes have distinct spatial and temporal sampling; Tables S8b,e,g retain endpoint changes, all process integrals and matched contrasts. Table S8j gives the first-return sensitivity of the integrals.
